# v1 alpha: session launch prompts

Local only. Plan: `.claude/plans/PLAN-v1-alpha-close-the-gap.md`. Open each session in `/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto`, set model and effort, paste the prompt. Sessions run unattended; they come back to you only to merge.

| Session | Work | `/model` | `/effort` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 Release model | F1 -> F2 -> G -> H -> M | Opus 5.5 | medium |
| 2 Publish chain | D -> L -> J | Sonnet 5.5 | medium |
| 3 Fixes | A, B, C (workflow), then K (after G merges) and N | Sonnet 5.5 | medium |
| 5 Identity and graph | E -> I | Sonnet 5.5 | medium |
| 4 Evidence (after E and F2 merge) | Q | Sonnet 5.5 | medium |

Opus spend is limited to Session 1 (one cross-cutting semantic change, where a rework loop costs more than Opus) and to subagents: an Opus design note at the start of L, E and Q, and the Opus reviewer per PR.

Capacity: disk is the limit (about 98 GB free; stale worktree `target/` dirs hold about 89 GB, all regenerable). With debug info off, expect a few GB per active worktree. Sessions 1, 3 (three Wave 0 worktrees) and 5 build at once from the start; Session 2 starts with them because J's first change is tiny, and its heavier builds overlap Wave 0 finishing.

Before launch, free the stale build output (build artifacts only, no source or branches touched):

```
cd ~/Projects/callisto && rm -rf .claude/worktrees/*/target
```

Launch all from a shell in the repo (each prints an id; `claude agents` lists them, `claude attach <id>` watches one):

```
cd ~/Projects/callisto
claude --bg --model opus   --effort medium "Run Session 1 in .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md."
claude --bg --model sonnet --effort medium "Run Session 2 in .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md."
claude --bg --model sonnet --effort medium "Use a workflow: run Session 3 in .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md."
claude --bg --model sonnet --effort medium "Run Session 5 in .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md."
# after E and F2 merge:
claude --bg --model sonnet --effort medium "Run Session 4 in .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md."
```

## Session 1

```
Implement work packages F1, F2, G, H, then M from .claude/plans/PLAN-v1-alpha-close-the-gap.md, one PR each, in order. Its root-cause table (R1, R6) and settled decisions are the spec. Trails: #457 for F1, F2, G, H; #458 for M. Link with `entire trail link`; do not create trails.
Done when: a pre cycle runs end to end through the release-PR flow (pre enter -> beta.0 -> fresh fix -> beta.1 -> nothing new -> no PR -> pre exit -> stable), inferred-only changes open a release PR, malformed-only changesets fail decide, and a Changesets v3 pre.json repo works mid-cycle.
Follow .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md "Rules".
```

## Session 2

```
Implement work packages D, L, then J from .claude/plans/PLAN-v1-alpha-close-the-gap.md, one PR each, in order. Its root-cause table (R3, R7) and settled decisions are the spec. Trails: #357 for D; #459 for L and J. Link with `entire trail link`; do not create trails.
Done when: generated workflows carry any valid branch name exactly in both templates; no job that runs project code holds id-token or registry credentials; npm-family publishes a packed tarball with --ignore-scripts; twine and crates.io can publish with no token through native OIDC (unproven against real registries until I run it).
Follow .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md "Rules".
```

## Session 3

```
Use a workflow for work packages A, B and C from .claude/plans/PLAN-v1-alpha-close-the-gap.md: one worktree and PR each, pipeline implement (sonnet) -> mutants -> fresh review (opus) -> gate, under 10 agents, cargo lock shared. Trail #357 for A, B, C.
Then K (after Session 1 merges G) and N, both on trail #458. Link with `entire trail link`; do not create trails.
Done when: policy recipes fail when cargo fails; the HTTP parser keeps a body with blank lines; JSON input errors carry their origin; a Changesets v2 or v3 config migrates with every ignored key reported; peer dependents get a patch by default.
Follow .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md "Rules".
```

## Session 5

```
Implement work packages E, then I from .claude/plans/PLAN-v1-alpha-close-the-gap.md, one PR each. Its root-cause table (R2, R4) and settled decisions are the spec. Trail #357.
Done when: equivalent PyPI or crates.io names cannot both be admitted and two such owners produce zero provider effects; relative workspace: lookup is indexed, with before/after bench numbers.
Follow .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md "Rules".
```

## Session 4 (after E and F2 merge)

```
Implement work package Q from .claude/plans/PLAN-v1-alpha-close-the-gap.md. Choose the narrowest test-only way past registry_endpoint.rs's https rule. Trail #460. Link with `entire trail link`; do not create trails.
Done when: `just verify-real` rehearses partial publish -> rerun adopts, delayed visibility, a conflicting tag and a missing Python artifact against local npm, cargo and PyPI registries through production registry binding, and exits nonzero on any wrong outcome.
Follow .claude/plans/LAUNCH-v1-alpha-sessions.md "Rules".
```

## Rules

- Before each WP: `git fetch`; re-verify the plan's finding against current main (other sessions merge in between). If another session already owns the WP's branch, skip to your next WP.
- Work in a named worktree per WP (EnterWorktree), branched off origin/main. No stacks. Each worktree builds into its own `target/`, so builds in different worktrees run in parallel with no lock; never run two builds in the same worktree.
- Build budget, exported once per session: `CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0` and `CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0` (debug info is most of each `target/`; dropping it cuts disk and link time), `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=$(( $(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN) / 4 ))` and the same value for nextest `--test-threads`, so four builders share the CPU.

38-| R4 | One resolution, two implementations, no index | F07 O(E x P) relative `workspace:` lookup (`walk.rs:34-68,776`; 12x at 800 packages); `npm.rs:92-113` resolves the same path again and swallows errors | Canonical-dir -> `PackageId` index built once; both callers use it |

Retained notes become `Source::RetainedChangeset` whichever shape stored them |

R7 must land before OIDC: with trusted publishing, a job holding `id-token` that runs build code can mint a publish token, because npm's trust is per workflow file unless bound to an environment, and this repo's policy forbids environments.
